verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's own docs show versioned API paths: a `/v2/parse` endpoint and llms.txt listing separate v2 and v1 documentation sets. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or migration guarantees, so only half the story is supported. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version support timelines, v1→v2 migration guidance, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Use `parse` to upload local files (`html`, `pdf`, `docx`, `xlsx`, etc.) directly to `/v2/parse`.
